## Checklist

- [ ] Any new tool is **keyless** (works against a free, public source).
- [ ] Tools fail soft — they return `{"error": ...}` instead of raising.
- [ ] `python server.py --selftest` passes.
- [ ] `python -m py_compile osint.py server.py` succeeds.
- [ ] No scratch, cache, or data files are included in the diff.
